title: llama.cpp
release_note: Initial release: llama.cpp server with Vulkan GPU acceleration (ghcr.io/ggml-org/llama.cpp:server).
tagline: Run GGUF LLMs locally with GPU acceleration
description:
llama.cpp is a pure C/C++ inference engine for GGUF large language models, with the official OpenAI-compatible server and a built-in Web UI.

**Key Features:**
- Run GGUF models (Llama, Qwen, DeepSeek, Gemma, Mistral and more) on CPU or GPU
- Vulkan backend works on AMD / Intel / NVIDIA GPUs out of the box
- Great fit for unified-memory machines (e.g. AMD Ryzen AI Max 395)
- OpenAI-compatible API for integration with Open WebUI, ChatGPT-Next-Web and more
- Built-in chat Web UI with runtime model loading

**Getting started:**
1. Put GGUF model files into the models volume (`/models`)
2. Open the Web UI at `http://<zima-ip>:18080` and load a model
3. Keep `/dev/dri` mapped for Vulkan acceleration; remove it for CPU-only mode
